# Red Ruby Cleaning Co.

> Cambridge's premier Airbnb and short-term let cleaning service. British owned and operated.

Red Ruby Cleaning Co. is a professional cleaning business based in Cambridge, UK, specialising in Airbnb cleaning, short-term let turnover cleaning, vacation rental cleaning, holiday let cleaning, and related property services.

## Business details

- **Trading name:** Red Ruby Cleaning Co.
- **Location:** Cambridge, UK
- **Website:** https://redrubycambridge.co.uk

## Key Facts

- British owned and operated from Cambridge
- Fully insured with public liability coverage
- All cleaners wear full Red Ruby uniform
- Founded by a local Cambridge single mum
- LGBTQ+ friendly and inclusive employer
- Eco-friendly cleaning products used as standard
- Serving Cambridge City Centre and surrounding areas

## Services Offered

- Airbnb Cleaning Cambridge
- Short Let Cleaning Cambridge
- Vacation Rental Cleaning Cambridge
- Holiday Let Cleaning Cambridge
- Turnover Cleaning Cambridge
- Booking.com Property Cleaning Cambridge
- End of Tenancy Cleaning Cambridge
- Deep Cleaning Cambridge
- Linen & Laundry Service Cambridge
- Property Management Cleaning Cambridge
- Student Let Cleaning Cambridge
- Serviced Accommodation Cleaning Cambridge

## Areas Covered

Cambridge City Centre, Newnham, Chesterton, Trumpington, Cherry Hinton, Arbury, King's Hedges, Romsey, Mill Road, Castle Hill, De Freville, Petersfield, Coleridge, Queen Edith's, West Chesterton, East Chesterton, Barnwell, Abbey, Eddington, Great Shelford, Girton, Histon, Impington, Milton, Cottenham, Bar Hill.
